title: Wall Harp Designer
description: Browser-based physics simulator and tuning calculator for a wall harp with a dual-capo tuning system — calculates string type, length and tension for musical intervals across a configurable wall, with Karplus-Strong plucked synthesis for auditioning each string.
technical: JavaScript, wave equation f = v / (2L), dual-capo pitch modelling, Karplus-Strong synthesis, up to 783 strings
